parts.text: Hello, what can you help me with?

Welcomes the user to FoldRun, summarizes the four supported structure prediction models (AlphaFold2, AlphaFold 3, OpenFold3, and Boltz-2), displays a configuration summary table (Project, Region, Models, AI Model), and offers example getting-started prompts.
When should I use AlphaFold2 for monomer folding versus Boltz-2 or AlphaFold3 for complex structure prediction in FoldRun?

Use AlphaFold2 for standard protein-only monomers and multimers (20 canonical amino acids). Use AlphaFold 3 (dedicated H100 endpoint with --msa-free or Full 630 GB MSA), OpenFold3 (multi-molecule complexes and RNA with nhmmer MSA), or Boltz-2 (covalent modifications, glycans, and ligand binding affinity) when predicting complexes containing small-molecule ligands, DNA, RNA, ions, or modified residues.
Which structure prediction models in FoldRun support folding a protein bound to a small-molecule SMILES ligand?

FoldRun supports protein-ligand complex prediction with small-molecule SMILES or CCD ligands using AlphaFold3, Boltz-2, and OpenFold3, whereas AlphaFold2 only supports standard amino acid monomer and multimer protein sequences.
What GPU capacity and quota do we have available in the project before I submit any jobs?
Calls check_gpu_quota and summarizes available GPU quotas across L4, A100, A100_80GB, and H100 tiers in the configured region along with DWS FLEX_START guidance.
Show me all recent structure prediction jobs in our project.
Calls list_jobs and reports the current and recent structure prediction jobs with their statuses, models, and job IDs.
Can you estimate the cost of running an AlphaFold2 monomer prediction for a 350-residue protein?
Calls estimate_job_cost with job_type='af2_monomer' and sequence_length=350, then presents an itemized cost breakdown across CPU MSA, GPU inference, relaxation, and total estimated USD.
Check if AlphaFold DB already has a predicted structure for UniProt accession P69905 before we fold it.
Calls query_alphafold_db_prediction or query_alphafold_db_summary for qualifier P69905 (human hemoglobin subunit alpha) and reports the existing AlphaFold DB structure metadata and confidence.
Can you check if there are any orphaned pipeline files or directories in our Cloud Storage bucket?
Calls find_orphaned_gcs_files and summarizes any orphaned GCS directories/FASTA files and their storage size before offering cleanup options.
Delete all Cloud Storage files for job af2-monomer-20260401-000000.

Enforces two-step HITL deletion safety: runs cleanup_gcs_files with confirm=False (dry run) first, reports discovered files/sizes, and asks for explicit user confirmation before executing permanent deletion with confirm=True.

Submit an AlphaFold2 monomer prediction for human ubiquitin:
>ubiquitin
MQIFVKTLTGKTITLEVEPSDTIENVKAKIQDKEGIPPDQQRLIFAGKQLEDGRTLSDYNIQKESTLHLVLRLRGG

Does NOT call submit_af2_monomer_prediction before user confirmation. Presents a Markdown pre-submission confirmation table showing Model (AlphaFold2 Monomer), Job Name, Input Summary (76 residues), Hardware Tier (L4 GPU auto-selected for <500 residues), Provisioning (FLEX_START / DWS), and Key Parameters (MMseqs2 GPU MSA, relax enabled), then asks the user to confirm.

Prepare a Boltz-2 structure prediction with ligand binding affinity enabled for ubiquitin (MQIFVKTLTGKTITLEVEPSDTIENVKAKIQDKEGIPPDQQRLIFAGKQLEDGRTLSDYNIQKESTLHLVLRLRGG) bound to aspirin (SMILES CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O). Show me the confirmation plan first.

Presents a pre-submission confirmation table for Boltz-2 with predict_affinity=True, single-character chain IDs (e.g. protein id 'A', ligand id 'B' with SMILES CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O), A100 GPU hardware tier, FLEX_START / DWS provisioning, and asks for user confirmation before calling submit_boltz2_prediction.
How do I interpret pLDDT, ipTM, and PDE metrics for an OpenFold3 or AlphaFold 3 complex prediction, and which tool opens the interactive 3D structure viewer?

Explains pLDDT (0-100 per-atom confidence: >=90 very high, 70-90 confident, 50-70 low, <50 disordered), ipTM (0-1 interface confidence: >0.8 high-confidence complex interface, 0.6-0.8 moderate, <0.6 uncertain), PDE/PAE (distance/alignment error in Angstroms where lower is better, <2 A rigid), and notes that open_structure_viewer launches the interactive 3D Mol* viewer.
